subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

Johnson wrote a drama in which he discusses the __study of chemistry in a medieval fashion. __
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e**. 'Alchemy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined group of words refers to discussing the study of chemistry in a medieval fashion, related to **alchemy **(Hindi: रसायन शास्त्र).

Therefore, the **correct answer** is : **'Alchemy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: **"Rhetoric" **refers to persuasive speaking or writing (Hindi: वक्पतृता).
 
• Option 2: **"Lexicography"** refers to the practice of compiling dictionaries (Hindi: शब्दकोश विज्ञान).
 
• Option 4: **"Anthropology"** refers to the study of humans and human behavior (Hindi: मानवशास्त्र).
